people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

translations.web: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.
translations.bsb: Then his father went to visit the woman, and Samson prepared a feast there, as was customary for the bridegroom.
translations.kjv: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
translations.asv: And his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
